brief:
Hamas called on the United Nations and international community to pressure Israel to allow specialized teams and experts into Gaza to address environmental contamination, Shehab Wire reported. The movement warned that bombing and use of explosive weapons have damaged air, soil, and water, with environmental consequences expected to persist for decades.

Hamas did not specify what access restrictions currently prevent international environmental teams from entering the territory or detail the particular contaminants of greatest concern.

title: Hamas demands international experts to combat Gaza's environmental crisis
